Date: YYYY-MM-DD
Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-NNNN | Rejected

## Context

What forced a decision. State the constraint, not the preference. If there was
no constraint, this probably does not need a record.

## Decision

What was decided, stated so that a reader can tell whether an implementation
complies with it.

## Consequences

Positive.

-

Negative.

- List real ones. An ADR with no negative consequences was not a decision, it
  was a preference.

## Alternatives rejected

Each alternative with the reason it was rejected. This section is why the
record exists. A future reader is usually asking "why not the obvious thing",
and this is where the answer lives.
